observations: Photo 0 shows a stainless steel 4-burner gas hob with black cast iron grates and four control knobs on the front panel.
Photo 1 and Photo 2 show the same hob wrapped in clear plastic, with a handwritten 'OIS' on the surface.
The plastic wrap is crumpled and shows signs of handling, with visible creases and smudges.
No brand name or model number is visible on the hob in any photo.
The seller's text mentions 'Tokunbo' (imported second-hand) and 'neatly used', but no visual evidence supports this.

claims.evidence: The plastic wrap and handwritten 'OIS' suggest it may be imported or used, but no visual proof of condition or usage history is provided. The surface shows smudges and creases, which may indicate use or handling.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The hob may have internal damage or gas leaks not visible from the outside.
risks.proof: A video showing the hob lit with all burners and a close-up of the gas connections and valves.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unsafe or non-functional

risks.risk: The plastic wrap may hide scratches, dents, or rust on the underside or edges.
risks.proof: Photos of the underside and edges of the hob, not wrapped.

risks.risk: The control knobs may be non-functional or misaligned.
risks.proof: A video showing each knob turning and the corresponding burner lighting.

proof_requests: Video of the hob lit with all burners, showing each knob turning and lighting.
Photos of the underside and edges of the hob, not wrapped.
Close-up of the gas connections and valves to check for damage or leaks.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
